citations.title: What's new at Bitly? – Bitly Support
excerpts: Dynamic Routing Send visitors to different destinations from a single Bitly Link or QR Code based on where they are, what device they're on, or what platform they use. Set up to 10 rules per link or code — Bitly evaluates them top to bottom and redirects each visitor to the first destination that matches. Anyone who doesn't meet a condition lands on the default destination.
